subject: Re: OpenMath: forward 20 final-packet enquiries and confirm the judging retrieval map
lines: Hi Serge and Artem, sorry for sending you so much work so close to the deadline.
Please don’t feel you need to forward those messages, I just wanted to make sure nobody with a potentially interesting result missed the chance to complete their submission.
Thanks for everything you’re doing to make this happen.
new_body:
Hi Serge and Artem, sorry for sending you so much work so close to the deadline.
Please don’t feel you need to forward those messages, I just wanted to make sure nobody with a potentially interesting result missed the chance to complete their submission.
Thanks for everything you’re doing to make this happen.
